items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: I had the pleasure of working with Don with Doc Palamer's band. He came to Jackson, and he played in the saxophone section with us

ctx.x: And there was also some other great saxophone players around Memphis. Two brothers, the Conway Brothers, one named Don, who played alto, and another one played tenor, his name was Buddy Conway. They were legendary through that part. And later on, I had the pleasure of working with Don with Doc Palamer's band. He came to Jackson, and he played in the saxophone section with us, you know. And he had his own band, yeah, out at a place called the Barn, a dance hall out in Memphis. And I was living right across from…
And I'll never forget, I think it was a little town named Marysville... Micki Gwynn(?), the singer with Don
